subject.title: fix(status): remove dead-code `|| 1` fallback in channel status display

question: Should this no-op cleanup wait for real behavior proof that reaches an account-count row, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate?
rationale: The source invariant is clear, but the external contributor proof currently does not demonstrate the changed display branch, so automation should not call the proof gate satisfied on its own.

options.title: Wait for branch-reaching proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output showing a configured multi-account or force-account-binding status row after the cleanup before merge.

options.title: Override proof for this cleanup
options.body: A maintainer may accept the source proof and existing CI as enough for this behavior-preserving cleanup.

recommendation.title: Wait for branch-reaching proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output showing a configured multi-account or force-account-binding status row after the cleanup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest status-command ownership history and was directly asked to review this PR in the discussion.
